current.text: He is healthy now after the Achilles tear.

The newest team preview projects him to start next to Scoot Henderson, with Toumani Camara, Deni Avdija and Donovan Clingan. Ja Morant is likely a bench player, and Jrue Holiday or Henderson starts most nights.
Experts reject the idea that he will be a 25-minute bench player. They cannot see him coming off the bench and expect him to start with about 30 to 31 minutes.
Expected to sit back-to-backs this season. Early-season back-to-backs are the main worry.
In the preseason he scored 14 points in 21 minutes, with a 24 usage rate and two steals.
The expert calls his preseason encouraging.
Portland is crowded with on-ball guards: Lillard, Morant, Holiday and Henderson, plus Avdija, all share the playmaking.
The crowded guard group adds risk to his usage and touches. Not all of the guards can match last season's numbers.
Portland has a first-time head coach who may mix up the lineup. Minutes and usage are expected to swing from game to game.

Experts call him a top 50 player who could reach the top 35, and one projection sees a possible top-30 season. They see good value anywhere after pick 50 and call an ADP in the 80s too low. His draft position is rising.
Expected to beat his ADP on a per-game basis.
Portland plays 10 games in our playoff weeks (season ending March 28), with three back-to-backs in those weeks. The team has 15 back-to-backs over the season.

durable.text: At age 36 and after an Achilles tear, age-related decline and missed time are the main risks. Re-injury is a smaller worry.
A very good shooter when playing off the ball.
An elite FT% shooter on real volume (about 92%). FT% is his clearest category edge.
FG% is his weak category for a guard (about 44% on 15 attempts per game), so he fits a punt FG% build.

note: Lillard's market prices are low: Yahoo rank 63 at a 3.5 USD average cost and ESPN rank 70 at 6.6 USD. The newest expert calls put him in the top 50 with top 30 upside, so he is a strong value target in the 10 to 17 USD range. His best fit is a punt FG% build that wants FT%, threes and assists from a guard. In the first weeks, check that he gets about 30 minutes as a starter, whether he sits back-to-backs and how much of the ball he gets next to Morant and Henderson. Also note that Portland has a weak 10-game playoff schedule, which makes him a possible sell before the deadline.
